name: Cooper Dagny
title: Of Hoops and Staves
examine: Forearms like bent staves and a laugh you can hear over a mallet. Every barrel in the province is on a first-name basis with her.
lines: The Flagon's cellar, the smelter's quench tubs, every cask on the High Road — mine, mine, and mine. I'm the most important person you'll meet today and the least famous.
A barrel is just a tree taught to hold its drink.
Stig sends me his straightest staves and keeps the crooked ones for chairs. That's friendship, in wood.
